content: For individuals with diabetes who are aged 40 years or older and do not have established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), the American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of moderate-intensity statin therapy as a primary prevention strategy. Clinical evidence demonstrates that this approach is effective in reducing the incidence of ASCVD events within this age group. The benefits of moderate-intensity statin therapy have been observed across diverse populations, including those with varying levels of cardiovascular risk factors.
